يحيوا (form I)
# يَحْيَوْا (yaḥyaw) /jaħ.jaw/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of حَيَّ (ḥayya) and حَيِيَ (ḥayiya)
# يُحْيَوْا (yuḥyaw) /juħ.jaw/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of حَيَّ (ḥayya)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
